about: The GRADE expected step lists the agentpile cross-check compares with, as frozen on 2026-10-24: the SHA-256 of each decompressed JSONL file, its run, step and dependency-edge counts, and the GRADE commit its lines record. The files were made from GRADE 3839a57 independently of agentpile, when agentpile's GRADE projection was built and checked. run_crosscheck.py refuses files that differ from this record.

agent_reward_bench.note: Regenerated for two runs on 2026-10-20 (E18, a mirror splice) with GRADE 3839a57's own to_steps on the pinned bytes, which added two edges (7,968 to 7,970). The meta written with the first version still records sha256 b1afdfa2... and 7,968 edges; this record is the revised file. agentpile's network test asserts the same 7,970.

tau2_bench.note: The tau2 converter at GRADE 3839a57 iterates a set and changes with PYTHONHASHSEED, so the reference is the frozen rule tau2-frozen-v1 on top of GRADE fe6e54d, as the grade_commit marker of every line says.

inputs_about: The source files each comparison reads, frozen on 2026-10-24 from the agentpile cache: for each corpus the number of files GRADE's expected runs come from, plus any file the reader joins into every run (AgentRewardBench's data/annotations.csv, SWE-rebench's tools.json; for CatchBench PRE, every data/pre/*.json file), and the SHA-256 of the sorted list of 'path<TAB>sha256' lines. run_crosscheck.py refuses inputs that differ and writes the per-file lines to --out.
